questions.questionText: A train 150 m long is running at a speed of 54 km/h. How much time will it take to cross a telephone pole?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Distance to cross pole = Train length = 150 m. Time = 150 / 15 = 10 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train 240 m long passes a platform of length 260 m in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 240 + 260 = 500 m. Speed = 500 / 25 = 20 m/s. In km/h = 20 * (18/5) = 72 km/h.

questions.questionText: Two trains 140 m and 160 m long run at speeds of 60 km/h and 40 km/h respectively in opposite directions on parallel tracks. What is the time taken by them to cross each other completely?

Two trains of lengths 120 m and 180 m are running in the same direction on parallel tracks at speeds of 42 km/h and 30 km/h respectively. In how many seconds will the faster train pass the slower train?
A train passes a standing man in 8 seconds and a platform 260 m long in 21 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.explanation: Let train length be L and speed be S. L = 8S. Also L + 260 = 21S. Subtracting: 260 = 13S => S = 20 m/s. Length L = 8 * 20 = 160 m.

questions.questionText: A train 125 m long passes a man, running at 5 km/h in the same direction in which the train is going, in 10 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 125 / 10 = 12.5 m/s. In km/h = 12.5 * (18/5) = 45 km/h. Since man runs in same direction, Train speed = Relative speed + Man speed = 45 + 5 = 50 km/h.

questions.questionText: A train running at 54 km/h takes 20 seconds to pass a bridge. Next, it passes another train 150 m long, running at 36 km/h in the opposite direction, in 12 seconds. Find the length of the bridge.
questions.explanation: Relative speed with 2nd train = 54 + 36 = 90 km/h = 25 m/s. Total distance in 12 s = 25 * 12 = 300 m. Length of 1st train = 300 - 150 = 150 m. Speed of 1st train = 54 km/h = 15 m/s. Distance in 20 s = 15 * 20 = 300 m. Length of bridge = 300 - 150 = 150 m.

questions.questionText: Two trains of equal length are running on parallel lines in the same direction at 46 km/h and 36 km/h. The faster train passes the slower train in 36 seconds. Find the length of each train.
A train 100 m long takes 9 seconds to cross a man walking at 5 km/h in the direction opposite to that of the train. Find the speed of the train in km/h.
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 100 / 9 m/s = (100/9) * (18/5) = 40 km/h. Opposite direction: Train speed + 5 = 40 => Train speed = 35 km/h.

questions.questionText: A train takes 18 seconds to pass through a platform 162 m long and 15 seconds to pass through another platform 120 m long. What is the length of the train?
questions.concept: Speed and Length from Platform Gap

questions.questionText: A train crosses a platform 100 m long in 60 seconds at a speed of 45 km/h. How much time will it take to cross a single electric post?
questions.explanation: Speed = 45 * (5/18) = 12.5 m/s. Distance in 60 s = 12.5 * 60 = 750 m. Train length = 750 - 100 = 650 m. Time to cross electric post = 650 / 12.5 = 52 seconds.
questions.concept: Derived Train Length Single Object Time

questions.questionText: A train 110 m long passes a telegraph post in 3 seconds. What is the time taken by it to cross a railway platform 165 m long?
questions.explanation: Speed = 110 / 3 m/s. Total distance for platform = 110 + 165 = 275 m. Time = 275 / (110/3) = (275 * 3) / 110 = 825 / 110 = 7.5 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long bridge in 20 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 * (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = 20 * 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.questionText: Two stations A and B are 110 km apart on a straight line. One train starts from A at 7 AM and travels towards B at 20 km/h. Another train starts from B at 8 AM and travels towards A at a speed of 25 km/h. At what time will they meet?
questions.explanation: In 1 hour (7 to 8 AM), Train A covers 20 km. Remaining distance at 8 AM = 110 - 20 = 90 km. Relative speed = 20 + 25 = 45 km/h. Time after 8 AM = 90 / 45 = 2 hours. Meeting time = 8 AM + 2 hours = 10:00 AM.

questions.questionText: A train 150 m long passes a tunnel of length 350 m in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
A passenger in a train notices that he can count 21 telephone posts in 1 minute. If the distance between two consecutive posts is 50 m, what is the speed of the train?
questions.explanation: 21 posts have 20 intervals of 50 m = 20 * 50 = 1000 m (1 km). Time = 1 minute = 1/60 hour. Speed = 1 km / (1/60 hr) = 60 km/h.

questions.questionText: Two trains start from stations P and Q towards each other at 50 km/h and 60 km/h. When they meet, it is found that the faster train has covered 120 km more than the slower train. Find the distance between P and Q.
questions.explanation: Speed difference = 10 km/h. Time to meet = 120 / 10 = 12 hours. Distance = (50 + 60) * 12 = 110 * 12 = 1,320 km.

questions.questionText: A train 800 m long is running at 78 km/h. If it crosses a tunnel in 1 minute, what is the length of the tunnel?
A goods train runs at 72 km/h. How many seconds does it take to cross a 250 m long platform if the goods train itself is 150 m long?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 150 + 250 = 400 m. Speed = 72 * (5/18) = 20 m/s. Time = 400 / 20 = 20 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train passes two persons walking in the same direction at 3 km/h and 5 km/h in 10 seconds and 11 seconds respectively. Find the speed of the train.
A train 120 m long is moving at 60 km/h. How much time will it take to cross a boy standing on the platform?
Two trains are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks at 42 km/h and 48 km/h. If each train is 150 m long, in how many seconds will they cross each other?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 150 + 150 = 300 m. Relative speed = 42 + 48 = 90 km/h = 25 m/s. Time = 300 / 25 = 12 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train 300 m long crosses a platform of length 200 m in 25 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 500 m. Speed = 500 / 25 = 20 m/s = 20 * (18/5) = 72 km/h.

questions.questionText: A train running at 90 km/h crosses a pole in 10 seconds. What is the length of the train?
A train 150 m long passes a man standing on a platform in 5 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
A train crosses a 375 m long bridge in 27 seconds and a 200 m long platform in 18 seconds. Find the length and speed of the train.
Two trains of length 100 m and 120 m are running in the same direction at 72 km/h and 54 km/h. How much time will the faster train take to overtake the slower train?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 100 + 120 = 220 m. Relative speed = 72 - 54 = 18 km/h = 5 m/s. Time = 220 / 5 = 44 seconds.

questions.questionText: A 180 m long train crosses another train of length 120 m running in the opposite direction in 6 seconds. If the speed of the first train is 80 km/h, what is the speed of the second train?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 180 + 120 = 300 m. Relative speed = 300 / 6 = 50 m/s = 50 * (18/5) = 180 km/h. Speed of 2nd train = 180 - 80 = 100 km/h.

questions.questionText: A train takes 5 seconds to pass an electric pole and 15 seconds to pass a railway platform 200 m long. What is the length of the train?
Two trains leave station X for station Y at 4:00 PM and 4:30 PM at speeds of 60 km/h and 75 km/h respectively. How far from X will the two trains be together?
questions.explanation: In 30 mins (1/2 hr), first train travels 60 * 0.5 = 30 km. Relative speed = 75 - 60 = 15 km/h. Time to catch up = 30 / 15 = 2 hours. Distance from X = 75 * 2 = 150 km.

questions.questionText: A train moving at 54 km/h crosses a platform in 30 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 18 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Train length = 15 * 18 = 270 m. Distance for platform = 15 * 30 = 450 m. Platform length = 450 - 270 = 180 m.

questions.questionText: A train 125 m long passes a telegraph post in 10 seconds. Find the time it will take to pass a bridge 175 m long.
questions.explanation: Speed = 125 / 10 = 12.5 m/s. Total distance for bridge = 125 + 175 = 300 m. Time = 300 / 12.5 = 24 seconds.

questions.questionText: Two trains A and B start from Howrah and Patna towards Patna and Howrah respectively. After passing each other, they take 4 hours 48 minutes and 3 hours 20 minutes to reach Patna and Howrah respectively. If train A is moving at 45 km/h, what is the speed of train B?
A 280 m long train crosses a platform thrice its length in 50 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
A train 110 m long is traveling at 60 km/h. In what time will it pass a man running at 6 km/h in the opposite direction?
A train passes a station platform in 36 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 20 seconds. If the speed of the train is 54 km/h, what is the length of the platform?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 * (5/18) = 15 m/s. Train length = 15 * 20 = 300 m. Total distance = 15 * 36 = 540 m. Platform length = 540 - 300 = 240 m.

questions.questionText: Two trains of equal length running in opposite directions pass a student standing beside the track in 18 seconds and 12 seconds respectively. In what time will the two trains cross each other completely?
questions.explanation: Shortcut for two trains crossing a point in t1 and t2: Time to cross each other = 2 * t1 * t2 / (t1 + t2) = 2(18)(12) / (18 + 12) = 432 / 30 = 14.4 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train 150 m long crosses a 500 m long bridge in 30 seconds. How long will it take to cross a 370 m long platform?
A train passes an electric pole in 15 seconds and passes a platform 100 m long in 25 seconds. Find the length of the train.
Two trains 130 m and 110 m long are going in the same direction at 40 km/h and 30 km/h. How long will they take to pass each other?
A train 100 m long running at 36 km/h crosses a bridge in 20 seconds. What is the length of the bridge?
questions.explanation: Speed = 36 * (5/18) = 10 m/s. Total distance = 10 * 20 = 200 m. Bridge length = 200 - 100 = 100 m.

questions.questionText: A train passes two men walking in the same direction at 2 km/h and 4 km/h in 9 seconds and 10 seconds respectively. Find the length of the train.
Two trains of lengths 200 m and 150 m are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks at 40 km/h and 45 km/h. How long will they take to cross each other?
A train 160 m long passes a platform 240 m long in 20 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
A train 180 m long is running at 72 km/h. How long will it take to pass an electric pole?
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 * (5/18) = 20 m/s. Time = 180 / 20 = 9 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train traveling at 60 km/h crosses a platform in 30 seconds. If the length of the train is 200 m, what is the length of the platform?
questions.explanation: Speed = 60 * (5/18) = 50/3 m/s. Total distance = (50/3) * 30 = 500 m. Platform length = 500 - 200 = 300 m.

questions.questionText: A train passes through a 160 m long tunnel in 18 seconds and a 200 m long tunnel in 20 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?

Two trains of equal length take 10 seconds and 15 seconds respectively to cross a telegraph post. If the length of each train be 120 m, in what time will they cross each other traveling in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Shortcut: Time to cross each other = 2 * 10 * 15 / (10 + 15) = 300 / 25 = 12 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train crosses a platform 120 m long in 15 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 9 seconds. What is the length of the train?
A train 125 m long passes a man running at 5 km/h in the direction opposite to the train in 5 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 125 / 5 = 25 m/s = 25 * (18/5) = 90 km/h. Train speed = 90 - 5 = 85 km/h.

questions.questionText: A train crosses a 300 m long platform in 38 seconds and another platform 200 m long in 28 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
Two trains 90 m and 110 m long are moving in the same direction on parallel tracks at 60 km/h and 36 km/h. What is the time taken by the faster train to cross the slower train?
A train moving at 72 km/h crosses a standing man in 7 seconds. How long will it take to cross a 140 m long bridge?
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 * (5/18) = 20 m/s. Train length = 20 * 7 = 140 m. Total distance for bridge = 140 + 140 = 280 m. Time = 280 / 20 = 14 seconds.

questions.questionText: Two trains 100 m and 80 m in length are running on parallel tracks. If they run in the same direction, the faster crosses the slower in 18 seconds, but if they run in opposite directions they cross each other in 9 seconds. Find the speed of the faster train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 180 m. Same direction: S1 - S2 = 180 / 18 = 10 m/s. Opposite direction: S1 + S2 = 180 / 9 = 20 m/s. Adding: 2 S1 = 30 => S1 = 15 m/s = 15 * (18/5) = 54 km/h.

questions.questionText: A train 120 m long passes a telegraph post in 6 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
A 150 m long train crosses a platform of length 250 m in 20 seconds. What is the time taken by it to cross a telephone pole?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 400 m. Speed = 400 / 20 = 20 m/s. Time to cross telephone pole = 150 / 20 = 7.5 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train 140 m long is moving at 90 km/h. In how many seconds will it cross another train 160 m long coming from the opposite direction at 54 km/h?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 140 + 160 = 300 m. Relative speed = 90 + 54 = 144 km/h = 144 * (5/18) = 40 m/s. Time = 300 / 40 = 7.5 seconds.

questions.questionText: A train crosses a 50 m long platform in 14 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 10 seconds. Find the speed of the train in km/h.
A train 200 m long crosses a 100 m long bridge in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 200 + 100 = 300 m. Speed = 300 / 15 = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

questions.questionText: Two trains of lengths 150 m and 180 m are running in the same direction at 50 km/h and 32 km/h. How many seconds will the faster train take to pass the slower train?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 150 + 180 = 330 m. Relative speed = 50 - 32 = 18 km/h = 5 m/s. Time = 330 / 5 = 66 seconds.
